description: This file contains shell script functions for managing firmware upgrades in the OpenWrt platform, including a check function and an upgrade function that delegates to a default upgrade routine based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image. Currently always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade by delegating to default_do_upgrade based on the board name.
